learningObjectives: Identify the essential components of a low-fidelity wireframe.
Create a basic screen layout based on user goals and information hierarchy.
Use wireframes to validate structure before applying visual styling.

activities.title: Wireframe Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the main parts of a wireframe.

content.concept: Wireframes define layout, hierarchy, navigation, and content placement without focusing on final visual styling.

activities.title: Wireframe Flow
activities.instruction: Connect screens into a usable task flow.
